list.name: boot_id
list.label: 주행
list.query:
import "date"
import "timezone"

seoul = timezone.location(name: "Asia/Seoul")

from(bucket: "crane_data")
    |> range(start: -30d)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "crane_sensor" and r._field == "position_mm")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.boot_id and r.boot_id != "")
    |> group(columns: ["boot_id"])
    |> min(column: "_time")
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
        _time: r._time,
        boot_id: r.boot_id,
        day: date.monthDay(t: r._time, location: seoul),
        month: date.month(t: r._time, location: seoul),
        n: 1.0,
    }))
    |> group(columns: ["month", "day"])
    |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
    |> cumulativeSum(columns: ["n"])
    |> group()
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
        _time: r._time,
        __value: r.boot_id,
        __text: string(v: r.month) + "월 " + string(v: r.day) + "일 " + string(v: int(v: r.n)) + "차 실험",
    }))
    |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
    |> keep(columns: ["__value", "__text"])

targets.query:
import "date"
import "timezone"
import "strings"

seoul = timezone.location(name: "Asia/Seoul")
raw = "${boot_id}"

runs = from(bucket: "crane_data")
    |> range(start: -30d)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "crane_sensor" and r._field == "position_mm")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.boot_id and r.boot_id != "")
    |> group(columns: ["boot_id"])
    |> min(column: "_time")
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
        _time: r._time,
        boot_id: r.boot_id,
        day: date.monthDay(t: r._time, location: seoul),
        month: date.month(t: r._time, location: seoul),
        n: 1.0,
    }))
    |> group(columns: ["month", "day"])
    |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
    |> cumulativeSum(columns: ["n"])
    |> group()
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
        __value: r.boot_id,
        __text: string(v: r.month) + "월 " + string(v: r.day) + "일 " + string(v: int(v: r.n)) + "차 실험",
    }))

parts = strings.split(v: raw, t: " · ")
tail = parts[length(arr: parts) - 1]
id = (runs
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.__value == raw or r.__value == tail or r.__text == raw or r.__text == tail)
    |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)).__value

from(bucket: "crane_data")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "crane_sensor")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "sensor_distance_mm")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.boot_id == id)
  |> group(columns: ["rail_side"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

panels.description: 엔코더 위치. 단위는 mm. 화면의 거리는 왼쪽 바퀴를 본다.
